context: Our proof strategy for Theorem 2 (and similar proof strategies used to bound partition rank in the past) cannot yield a lower bound on prk(detn ) better than logarithmic (see Remark 16). It remains open whether a different strategy could do better. ▶ Problem 1. Determine the asymptotics of prk(detn ). One can also ask about expansions of the determinant where the factors need not be multilinear. This corresponds to the strength (or rank) of detn , where for any form P , str(P ) is the least number of reducible forms that sum to P . For this notion, even obtaining any nontrivial bound is open.
